title: Cybercrime & Online Fraud
summary: For scams, hacked accounts and other crimes with a digital trail.
whatToDoNow: If money is being moved right now (UPI, card, net banking), call 1930 immediately. Speed matters for freezing funds.
Do not delete the messages, emails, app data or call logs involved.
Change passwords on the affected account and any account that reuses the same password.
If a device may be compromised, disconnect it from Wi-Fi and mobile data until you have reviewed it.
whoToContact: 1930, National Cybercrime Reporting Helpline (urgent financial fraud)
Your bank's official fraud number, taken from your card or bank app, not from the suspicious message
Your local police station or cyber cell if you need a formal complaint
whereToReport: File a detailed complaint on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in)
Use Sanchar Saathi if a phone or SIM is involved
whatInformationToKeep: Exact date and time of the incident
Transaction IDs, UPI reference numbers or account numbers involved
The sender's phone number, email, UPI ID or website address
Names of apps involved and how they were installed
whatEvidenceToPreserve: Screenshots of messages, emails or websites
Screen recordings of the transaction flow, if possible
Bank SMS and email alerts for the transaction
